parsed_json.up: Select molecule ChEMBL ID, name, development phase, type, and canonical SMILES for all molecules reported in document CHEMBL4613212. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4613212'. Return the columns molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id ascending.
